name: NMN (nicotinamide mononucleotide)
description: Molecule the body uses to make the coenzyme NAD+; treated by EFSA as a source of niacin (vitamin B3)

status.usStatus: Not FDA approved · sold as a supplement

note.text: No trial has measured aging or lifespan in people. A 2026 meta-analysis of 15 small trials found no clear effect on weight, sugar or cholesterol.

bullets: **Used by the body to make NAD+,** a coenzyme cells need for energy
**NAD+ availability falls with age** in mice
**In people,** effects on aging are not established
Drug form MIB-626 in Phase 2 trials

practical.pharmacokinetics: Blood NAD+ rose with dose (MIB-626, 14 days)
practical.monitored: Blood NAD+, adverse events, liver enzymes

regulatory.text: Panel opinion on β-NMN as a novel food (May 2026)

references: Nutrients, meta-analysis of 15 randomized NMN trials, Jul 2026
Science, NMN and muscle insulin sensitivity in prediabetic women, Jun 2021
